999008199.text:
ここがランターナ王国の王都か……！
ケイウンとはまた違った美しさがあるな！

localizations.en: So this is the royal capital of the Kingdom of Lantarna...! It has a different aura of elegance to Keiun!

999008199.text: 広々としていて綺麗な街並みですね……

localizations.en: It's so spacious and the streets are so lovely...

999008199.text:
そうなりますよね。
私も初めて王都に来た時はそうでした

localizations.en: I know the feeling. I was the same way when I first came to the capital.

999008199.text: おのぼりさんみたいにキョロキョロしてたよね

localizations.en: You were gawking around like a total tourist.

999008199.text: 実際そうだったんだからしょうがないよ～

localizations.en: Well, that's exactly what I was, so I couldn't help it!

999008199.text:
そこの素敵なお嬢さん、
出会いを記念して我が陰陽術の妙技を……

localizations.en: Excuse me, beautiful lady. To commemorate our meeting, allow me to demonstrate the wonders of my divination arts...

999008199.text:
永遠、いきなりケイウンの名に泥を塗るのは
ご容赦願いまする

localizations.en: Towa, I must ask you to refrain from immediately tarnishing Keiun's reputation.

999008199.text:
まぁ５人ぐらいには振られるだろうな。
千歳は何人だと思う

localizations.en: Well, he'll probably get turned down by about five women. Chitose, how many do you think?

999008199.text: 賭けごとにするなよ！

localizations.en: Why are you betting on that!

999008199.text:
……ところで、ロマン殿。ランターナの王族にも、
拙者のような忍びが付いているのでしょうか？

localizations.en: ...By the way, Roman. Does Lantarna's royal family also have shinobi like myself in their service?

999008199.text: なんのことだい？

アタシみたいなお付きの騎士はいるけど、
忍者はいないよ？

localizations.en: They've got attendant knights like me, but no ninja.

999008199.text:
そうなのですか？
では今我々を監視しているのはいったい？

localizations.en: Is that so? Then who is currently monitoring us?

999008199.text: え……み、見られてるんですか？

はい。とりあえず悪意や敵意はありませぬし、
人が多いので襲われる心配はなさそうですが

localizations.en: Yes. But I don't sense any no malice or hostility. And with this many people around, an attack seems unlikely.

999008199.text:
気になるなら、少し場所を変えるかい？
ちょうどお腹も空いてきた頃だろう

localizations.en: If it bothers you, we could move somewhere else? You must all be getting hungry by now anyway.

999008199.text: ほう、食事処を案内してくれるのか？

localizations.en: Oh? You'll bring us to a dining establishment?

999008199.text: ああ。いい店を知っているんだ

localizations.en: Of course. I know a great place.

999008199.text: た、大陸のお食事……楽しみです

localizations.en: M-Meals from the continent... I'm looking forward to it.

999008199.text:
え～と、あっちがケイウンの領主、鏑矢さんで
レスナちゃんはホルハーツで見てるよね、うん

localizations.en: Let's see, that's Kaburaya, the lord of Keiun, and we saw Resna in Holhartz, right? Yeah.

999008199.text: 事前に確認した人相と一致。引き続き監視を遂行する

localizations.en: Physical description matches prior reconnaissance. Continuing surveillance.

999008199.text: よーし、やるだけやろう

localizations.en: All right, let's do what we can.

999008199.text:
あちらも我々の存在を感知している模様。
注意を要する

localizations.en: They appear to have detected our presence. Caution advised.

999008199.text: 騒ぎになると大変だから隠れてこっそりいこうね

localizations.en: We'd better stay hidden so we don't cause a scene.

999008199.text:
……監視は私のみで続行可能。
キューンは、姉上たちに同行しても問題ない

localizations.en: ...I can continue surveillance alone. As for you, feel free to join our sisters.

999008199.text:
ああ、魔物の間引きね。あっちも気になるけど、
せっかくなら王都の美味しいものとか食べたいし？

localizations.en: Oh, the monster culling, right? I'm curious about that too, but since we're here, I'd really like to try some of the capital's delicious food.

999008199.text: ……お小遣いの範囲なら、好きなだけ食べるといい

localizations.en: ...If it's within your allowance, eat as much as you like.

999008199.text:
それにヤド姉が一人になっちゃうし。
一緒にいよ

localizations.en: Besides, I don't want to leave you all alone. Let's stay together.

999008199.text: 諾。キューンと一緒

じゃあこのまま監視続行ね。
それにしても、カフェかあ、いいなあ

localizations.en: Then let's keep watch from a distance. But man, a cafe sounds nice.

999008199.text:
さっき聞いたんだけど、「ロロナのパイ」ってのが
美味しいらしいよ。食べてみたいなぁ

localizations.en: I heard earlier that something called Rorona's Pie is supposed to be really good. I'd love to try it.

999008199.text:
うむ……いとうまし！　ケイウンでは見ないが
こういった菓子もたまには悪くない！

localizations.en: This is delicious! We don't have sweets like this in Keiun, but having them occasionally is wonderful!

999008199.text:
材料はなんとかなるかも……ですけど、
この味は再現できないかも、です

localizations.en: We might be able to find similar ingredients... but I don't think I could recreate this flavor.

999008199.text:
ロロナ先輩のパイへの愛情が籠っているんです。
他の誰にも真似できない味ですよ！

localizations.en: Miss Rorona puts her love for pies into every one she makes. It's a taste no one else can replicate!

999008199.text:
錬金術士とパイ職人の二刀流……
彼女はすごい才能の持ち主だよね

localizations.en: As an alchemist and pie maker both... She's incredibly talented.

999008199.text:
良い人材はかき集めたいものだ……っと、
錬金術で思い出した。九偉人図についての続報だが……

localizations.en: I'd love to recruit talented people like that... Ah, speaking of alchemy, I have an update about the Portrait of the Nine.

999008199.text:
ケイウンの宝物庫にあった絵画は
他の島からの貢ぎ物のようであった

localizations.en: The painting in Keiun's treasury appears to have been a tribute from another island.

999008199.text: じゃあ、贈り元の島がどこか分かれば……

localizations.en: Then if we can find out which island sent it...

999008199.text:
うむ。他の九偉人図もあるやもしれぬ。
今しばらく待っていてくれ

localizations.en: Indeed. There may be other Portraits of the Nine there. Give me a little more time.

999008199.text: はい……！　調査、よろしくお願いします！

localizations.en: Certainly...! Thank you so much for looking into it!
